products.name: Original Flavor Beef Jerky
products.short_description: The one that started it all.
products.description: Not “regular.” Never regular. Our Original Flavor brings savory seasoning, a gentle peppery kick, and the rich hickory-smoke character that put Sograte on the map. A Texas classic with just enough attitude to keep every bite interesting.
products.original_description: We do not call it "Regular" for a reason, this is the Sograte Original Flavor Beef Jerky! Original, because of the unique one of a kind flavor unlike any "regular" flavor. Original Beef Jerky - Well seasoned and slow smoked with a hickory fire. Original Sograte Hickory Smoked Beef Jerky is a little bit spicy because that is how we believe beef jerky should be. Tender mouths might experience a slight tingling burning sensation, but the heat is not the signature feature. The focus is on the natural hickory smoke flavor. Our all natural flavor comes from a unique blend of spices sprinkled atop of fresh cuts of lean top round beef then slow smoked with a live hickory fire. Our spice blend is designed to naturally enhance the wonderful flavor of the slow smoked meat. The result is a beef jerky flavor unlike anything you may have experienced before. This item consists of more than al pound of Sograte Original Beef Jerky in 6 - 3oz reclosable bags.

products.description: Habanero takes center stage in this fiery favorite. Crushed pepper and bold seasoning build serious, lingering heat, while hickory smoke brings it all together. Made for chile lovers who like their jerky with a challenge.

Smokin Habanero Sograte Hickory Smoked Beef Jerky is dusted with our great dry rub featuring a heavy load of dried and crushed habanero peppers. This is the gift that keeps on giving. The heat is intense and will leave a lingering burn for quite some time. Not for the casual jerky eaters. products.name: Chili Lime Beef Jerky
products.short_description: Bright lime. Gentle chile. Texas smoke.
products.description: A lively combination of tangy lime, mild chile, savory spices and hickory-smoke character. This flavor walks the line between bright and smoky, with a gentle kick that invites another bite.
products.original_description: Chili Lime beef jerky utilizes a Sograte combination of mild chili and tangy lime along with our unique blend of spices for a classic Latin flavor with a Texas twist. We season and slow smoke the lean muscle meat over a hickory fire giving you a flavorful beef jerky with a gental heat, slight tang and some Texas style hickory smoke.

products.name: Teriyaki Beef Jerky
products.short_description: Sweet meets savory—with a smoky finish.
products.description: A carefully balanced blend of sweet, salty and gently spicy flavors, layered with Sograte’s signature hickory-smoke character. The original recipe featured a house-made teriyaki sauce applied before smoking for a bold, satisfying finish.
products.original_description: Sograte Teriyaki Beef Jerky focuses on a balance of sweet, salty and spicy flavor and is rounded out with our signature hickory smoke flavor. Our very own teriyaki sauce is made in house and features our unique blend of spices. As with all Sograte Beef Jerky, we do not marinade in soy sauce so the meat retains its natural flavor and texture. We carefully apply the teriyaki sauce before loading the meat in the smokehouse for smoke curing. All of this comes together as a very balanced beef jerky flavor that explodes in your mouth with every bite.
